newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts home, condo sales up sharply in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts home, condo sales up sharply in Jan.

text.p: Sales of single family homes and condominums rose sharply in January, according to figures released by the Massachusetts Association of Realtors on Friday.

Sales of single family homes rose 10.2 percent in January 1997 to 2,569 as compared with the same month last year when 2,332 homes were sold. The average selling price rose to $190,069 in January 1997 up 4.1 percent from $182,631, a year earlier.

Condominium sales were also up sharply last month with 485 units being sold in comparison to 403 a year earlier. The average selling price for a condominium was $131,409 up from $108,598 in January 1996.
"What you are seeing is the result of a recovery made against the backdrop of very stable interest rates and a rise in employment," said Richard Dils, head of the association.
Massachusetts earlier reported that the average jobless rate in the state during 1996 was 4.3 percent.
